reason: First baseline for the native-visual layout gate (issue #309). Thresholds are set so app-drawn ink on the window buttons and an empty content layer fail, and so the rules that read the element inventory report without failing until a hosted run shows what that inventory contains.
beforeArtifact: Settings before the fix: the sidebar mark and headline printed over the window buttons and every image-gate check still passed. Recorded as tests/fixtures/native-visual/settings-traffic-light-overlap.layout.json, and reproduced live by NativeVisualLayoutAuditTests.testStandaloneSettingsWindowKeepsItsHeaderOffTheWindowControls, which fails on the pre-fix view with control-zone-ink range=0.430.
afterArtifact: Settings after the fix, captured locally with the same hosted fixture the workflow runs, along with terminal, mixed, mesh, topbar, onboarding, usage, settings-mcp, workspace-rename and account-picker: gate PASS on all ten, 26 observations, no failures.
howToUpdate: 2. Run native-visual before and after, and download both artifacts.
3. Look at the screenshots the change affects, not only the gate log.
4. Put the new digest (shasum -a 256 layout-expectations.json), your name, the date, the reason, and both artifact references here.
The gate fails the whole run while the digest and this record disagree, so a baseline cannot move without step 3 having a name attached to it.
